A '''female''' was the [[Grievous's family/Legends|great-grandmother]] of the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Grievous/Legends|Qymaen jai Sheelal]]. The [[Gender/Legends|female]] fought<ref name="Lord of War" /> alongside the [[Kolkpravis]], the united [[Army/Legends|army]] of the Kaleesh of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalee/Legends|Kalee]] in the [[Bitthævrian War]] in approximately [[65 BBY/Legends|65 BBY]].<ref name="Galaxy at War">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref> The war was instigated when corrupt [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] officials secretly trained the Kaleesh<ref name="Lord of War" /> and armed them with [[Outland rifle/Legends|Outland rifles]]<ref name="Galaxy at War" /> made by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]]<ref name="Lord of War" /> to fight the [[Bitthævrian/Legends|Bitthævrian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] in the [[Kadok Regions/Legends|Kadok Regions]],<ref name="Galaxy at War" /> on which Kalee bordered.<ref name="Lord of War" />

The female fought against the advance by the Bitthævrians,<ref name="Lord of War" /> and their great-grandson also participated in the [[Invasion of Guiteica|storming]] of [[Guiteica/Legends|Guiteica]], the Bitthævrian [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="Clone Wars Episode Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Official Episode Guide Series 1 & 2]]''</ref> Sheelal, who later changed his name to Grievous after becoming a [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]], inherited his great-grandmother's Outland [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]]<ref name="Lord of War" /> and was tought to use it by his [[Grievous's father/Legends|father]] prior to turning eight [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old.<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|86|Unknown Soldier: The Story of General Grievous}}</ref> The rifle was either lost or destroyed when Grievous's [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], the ''[[Martyr]]'', crashed<ref name="Lord of War" /> by [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]]<ref name="Date">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]'' states that [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] reconstruction, as described by "[[The Story of General Grievous: Lord of War]]" to have occurred following his [[Martyr|shuttle]] crash, had taken place a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] earlier, and ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the novel in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. Therefore, the ''Martyr'' must have crashed by [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]].</ref> on [[Kalee/Legends|Kalee]].<ref name="Eyes">{{StoryCite|story=The Eyes of Revolution|book=Star Wars: Visionaries}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Grievous's great-grandmother was mentioned in "[[The Story of General Grievous: Lord of War]]," an article written by [[Abel G. Peña]] and published in [[2006]] on [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]], a subscription service on [[StarWars.com]].<ref name="Lord of War" />
